reason: The README describes a session archive and knowledge-management plugin centered on automatic archiving, folder organization, searchable LLM-generated summaries, bookmarks, notes, and session restoration.

summaries.zh: 用于自动归档和整理 DSH 会话，并通过摘要、搜索、收藏与便签帮助建立可检索的经验库。
summaries.en: A DSH plugin for automatically archiving and organizing sessions while building a searchable knowledge library with summaries, bookmarks, and notes.

capabilities: Automatically archives idle sessions on a schedule
Organizes, moves, restores, and exports archived sessions
Generates LLM summaries and stores them as a searchable knowledge library
Persists folders, bookmarks, notes, and summaries in local DSH storage
Provides a button to shut down DSH through a host RPC
